caption:
10 Minute Salsa, just like in your favorite restaurant

This is perfect for light snacking with nacho chips and as an accompaniment in an indulgent Mexican dish.

Ingredients:
-2 medium tomatoes, seeds removed and cut into cubes
-1 onion, chopped
-2 green chillies, chopped
-chopped coriander leaves
-the juice of one lemon
-1 tsp cumin powder
-1 tsp ground black pepper
-1/2 tsp red chilli powder
-salt, to taste

Method:
-Add all your ingredients to a bowl and mix together
